subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The ball of yarn was being nudged by the kitten.

options.text: The kitten was nudged by the ball of yarn.
The kitten is nudging the ball of yarn.
The kitten was nudging the ball of yarn.
The kitten has been nudging the ball of yarn.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The kitten was nudging the ball of yarn.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In active voice, the subject of the sentence performs the action.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject (ball of yarn) is receiving the action (nudged) and the verb is in passive voice.
 
• **To convert the sentence into active voice:**
 
 
• **We need to make the subject (kitten) perform the action (nudging) on the object (ball of yarn).**
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence in active voice is "The kitten was nudging the ball of yarn."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
